major_factions.name: Maruuk Centaur
major_factions.description: Centaur clans roam the Ohn'ahran Plains, where they follow the call of the wind and seek the thrill of the hunt.
major_factions.unlock_description: Complete the quest Maruukai with the centaur caravan in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

rewards.name: Among the Maruuk Centaur
rewards.description: You have joined forces with the Maruuk Centaurs on the Ohn'ahran Plains.

rewards.name: Centaur Hunting Trophies
rewards.description: You may find Centaur Hunting Trophies from unique beasts and treasures to increase your standing with the Maruuk Centaurs.

rewards.name: Centaur Furnishings
rewards.description: You may acquire the toys Maruuk Cooking Pot, Very Comfortable Pelt, and Comfortable Pile of Pelts from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Plains
rewards.description: The Aylaag Nomads will welcome you into their camp, wherever it happens to be.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt I
rewards.description: Join the hunt alongside the Shikaar centaurs!

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts I
rewards.description: You may acquire four new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Windborne Velocidrake (Horned Jaw, Yellow Horns, Feathered Neck, Ox Horns) from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Armaments I
rewards.description: You may acquire twelve cosmetic helm appearances from Farrier Rondare in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Essence of Awakening
rewards.description: You may acquire Essence of Awakening from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai, which allows you to see and interact with Maruuk ancestors.

rewards.name: Centaur Enchanting
rewards.description: You may acquire Formula: Enchant Boots - Plainsrunner's Breeze and Formula: Enchant Chest - Sustained Strength from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: A Centaur's Companion
rewards.description: You may acquire a Hoofhelper battle pet from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt II
rewards.description: You may recruit a companion while hunting alongside the Maruuk Centaurs, chosen at Trainer Frodrum in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Replacement Hooves
rewards.description: You may return to Radiya in the Ohn'iri Springs and help raise a thunder lizard to earn its loyalty (and eventually to use as a mount).|n|nYou must first complete the quest chain beginning with "A Disgruntled Initiate", acquired from Windsage Ordven in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt III
rewards.description: You may select a hunter's blessing while hunting alongside the Maruuk Centaurs, chosen at Trainer Frodrum in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Aylaag Windstones
rewards.description: You may acquire Aylaag Windstone Fragments from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai. These return you to the current location of the Aylaag camp.

rewards.name: Friendly Farrier
rewards.description: You may acquire useful combat boots from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Hunting Efficiency I
rewards.description: You gain a 25% chance to get additional Dragon Isles Supplies from defeated beasts.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt IV
rewards.description: Your hunting companion may gain your choice of a new ability, chosen at Trainer Frodrum in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Armaments II
rewards.description: You may acquire twelve cosmetic shoulder appearances of the Maruuk from Farrier Rondare in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Alchemy I
rewards.description: You may acquire Recipe: Alacritous Alchemist Stone from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Blacksmithing I
rewards.description: You may acquire Plans: Obsidian Seared Halberd, Plans: Obsidian Seared Runeaxe, and Plans: Obsidian Seared Facesmasher from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Leatherworking I
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Ancestor's Dew Drippers and Pattern: Allied Legguards of Sansok Khan from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Ohn'ahran Friendship
rewards.description: Gain access to the Maruuk's eagle mail network with the help of Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Crafter's Knowledge I
rewards.description: You will receive Maruuk crafter's knowledge from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts II
rewards.description: You may acquire four new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Windborne Velocidrake (Spiked Tail, Long Snout, Hairy Head, Feathered Back) from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Inscription I
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Windborne Velocidrake: Black Fur from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt V
rewards.description: You become stronger while hunting beside the Maruuk Centaurs.

rewards.name: Centaur Armaments III
rewards.description: You may acquire cosmetic appearances of centaur weapons and shields from Weaponmaster Aloom in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Hunting Efficiency II
rewards.description: You gain an additional +25% chance to get additional Dragon Isles Supplies from defeated beasts, for a total of +50%.

rewards.name: Centaur Leatherworking II
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Expert Alchemist's Hat, Pattern: Flameproof Apron, Pattern: Masterwork Smock, and Pattern: Reinforced Pack from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Blacksmithing II
rewards.description: You may acquire Plans: Khaz'gorite Leatherworker's Knife and Plans: Khaz'gorite Skinning Knife from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts III
rewards.description: You may acquire two new Drakewatcher Manuscripts to provide Green Scales to your Renewed Proto-Drake, Highland Drake, and Cliffside Wylderdrake from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt VI
rewards.description: You become even stronger while hunting beside the Maruuk Centaurs.

rewards.name: Pennants of the Maruuk
rewards.description: You may acquire pennants of several centaur clans from Farrier Rondare in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt VII
rewards.description: You become yet stronger still while hunting beside the Maruuk Centaurs.

rewards.name: Centaur Inscription II
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Contract: Maruuk Centaur from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Alchemy II
rewards.description: You may acquire Recipe: Exultant Incense from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Leatherworking III
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Finished Prototype Explorer's Barding from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Centaur Blacksmithing III
rewards.description: You may acquire Plans: Prototype Explorer's Barding Framework from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Call of the Hunt VIII
rewards.description: You may acquire a Shikaar Hunting Horn from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai to use your Maruuk hunting abilities while adventuring in the outdoor Dragon Isles.

rewards.name: An Ally's Armor
rewards.description: You may acquire useful combat chest armor from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: Crafter's Knowledge II
rewards.description: You will receive additional Maruuk crafter's knowledge from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai.

rewards.name: The Wind's Recognition
rewards.description: You may bear a title fitting your alliance with the Maruuk centaurs after a visit with Khanam Matra Sarest in Maruukai.

rewards.name: A Heroic Reward
rewards.description: You will receive a Primal Infusion from the Maruuk for your service after a visit with Khanam Matra Sarest in Maruukai. This can be used as an optional reagent to increase a crafted item's level.

major_factions.name: Dragonscale Expedition
major_factions.description: A joint expedition of the Explorers' League and Reliquary, this fearless group of adventurers, scholars, and crafters seek to uncover the many mysteries of the Dragon Isles.
major_factions.unlock_description: Complete the quest Explorer's in Peril near the Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.

rewards.name: The Dragonscale Expedition
rewards.description: You have begun your adventures with the Dragonscale Expedition!

rewards.name: Expedition Scout Packs
rewards.description: You may now find Expedition Scout packs around the Dragon Isles. Speak with Pathfinder Jeb in the Dragonscale Basecamp for more details.

rewards.name: Simple Expedition Tools
rewards.description: You may acquire the cosmetic weapon appearances Excavator's Mallet, Excavator's Punch, Excavator's Chisel, and Excavator's Trowel from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Expedition Cloaks
rewards.description: You may acquire cosmetic Dragonscale Expedition Cloaks from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Buried Treasures
rewards.description: You may use your Expedition Shovel to find and dig through Disturbed Dirt mounds. A shovel can be purchased from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Blacksmithing
rewards.description: You may acquire Plans: Enduring Shovel from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Climbers
rewards.description: You may unlock the challenge of rock climbing in the Dragon Isles. Doc Nanners at the Dragonscale Basecamp will help you get started. (Requires World Quests Unlocked)

rewards.name: Expedition Supply Kit
rewards.description: You may seek out Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp to acquire your Expedition Supply Kit. This kit will assist you with Dragonscale Expedition activities.

rewards.name: Advanced Expedition Tools
rewards.description: You may acquire the cosmetic weapon appearances Expedition Excavator, Trusty Sweeper, and Researcher's Magnifier from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates I
rewards.description: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to unlock a pair of Ancient Waygates that can be used to transport between the Rubyscale Outpost and the Cobalt Assembly.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates II
rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to a third Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Cataloging the Expedition
rewards.description: Unlock access to the Cataloging Expeditions across the Dragon Isles. Doc Nanners at the Dragonscale Basecamp will help you get started. (Requires World Quests Unlocked)

rewards.name: Wayfinder's Compass
rewards.description: Receive the Wayfinder's Compass Toy from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Jewelcrafting I
rewards.description: You may acquire Design: Radiant Malygite, Design: Energized Malygite, Design: Sensei's Neltharite, and Design: Keen Neltharite from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts I
rewards.description: You may acquire four new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Renewed Proto-Drake (Spined Brow, Maned Crest, Spiked Jaw, Brown Hair) from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Engineering I
rewards.description: You may acquire Schematic: Gravitational Displacer and Schematic: Primal Deconstruction Charge from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Enchanting I
rewards.description: You may acquire Formula: Enchant Cloak - Graceful Avoidance and Formula: Enchant Boots - Rider's Reassurance from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates III
rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to a fourth Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Bonus Supplies
rewards.description: You gain a 25% chance to get additional Dragon Isles Supplies from treasure chests on the Dragon Isles.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Decor I
rewards.description: You may acquire three Reliquary-themed rug decor to place in your house from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Decor II
rewards.description: You may acquire additional Reliquary-themed decor to place in your house from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Decor III
rewards.description: You may acquire a Reliquary telescope decor to place in your house from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Animal Specialist
rewards.description: You may acquire the Gray Marmoni and Black Skitterbug battle pets from Granpap Whiskers at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygate: The Forbidden Reach
rewards.description: Complete the Forbidden Reach introductory campaign, and then seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to the Forbidden Reach's Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Expedition Equipment I
rewards.description: You may acquire a pair of useful combat Expedition gloves from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Jewelcrafting II
rewards.description: You may acquire Design: Idol of the Earth-Warder and Design: Idol of the Life-Binder from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Cooking
rewards.description: You may acquire Recipe: Salad on the Side from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragon Isles Supplies
rewards.description: Seek out Cataloger Jakes in the Dragonscale Basecamp to receive a Small Dragonscale Expedition Supply Pack.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Expedition Ensembles
rewards.description: You may acquire cosmetic Dragonscale Expedition Ensembles from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Crafter's Knowledge I
rewards.description: You will receive Dragonscale Expedition crafter's knowledge from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates IV
rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to a fifth Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Expedition Tailoring I
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Master's Wildercloth Fishing Cap, Pattern: Master's Wildercloth Chef's Hat, Pattern: Explorer's Banner of Herbology, and Pattern: Explorer's Banner of Geology from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Jewelcrafting III
rewards.description: You may acquire Design: Magnificent Margin Magnifier from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Engineering II
rewards.description: You may acquire Schematic: Bottomless Mireslush Ore Satchel and Schematic: Spring-Loaded Khaz'gorite Fabric Cutters from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Inscription I
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Renewed Proto-Drake: Spined Crest Manuscript from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts II
rewards.description: You may acquire four new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Renewed Proto-Drake (Spiked Club Tail, Swept Horns, Harrier Pattern, Curved Spiked Brow) from Rae'ana at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Magical Treasure Chests
rewards.description: You may now find magical treasure chests in the caves and ruins of the Dragon Isles. Speak with Rae'ana in the Dragonscale Basecamp for more information.

rewards.name: Expedition Tailoring II
rewards.description: You may acquire the Pattern: Cold Cushion and Pattern: Dragonscale Expedition's Expedition Tent from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Researching in Comfort
rewards.description: You may acquire the toys Soft Purple Pillow, Skinny Reliquary Pillow, and Small Triangular Pillow from Rae'na at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates V
rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to a sixth Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Bonus Supplies II
rewards.description: You gain an additional +25% chance to get additional Dragon Isles Supplies from treasure chests, for a total of +50%.

rewards.name: Expedition Equipment II
rewards.description: You may acquire a pair of useful leg armor from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Tailoring III
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Azureweave Expedition Pack from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Inscription II
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Dragonscale Expedition Contract from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragonscale Expedition Tabard
rewards.description: Unlock the Dragonscale Expedition Tabard from Cataloger Jakes at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Banners of the United Factions
rewards.description: You may acquire the banners for both the Reliquary and Explorers' League (now that they are united in the Dragonscale Expedition) from Cataloger Jakes at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Explosive Archaeology
rewards.description: You may acquire Expedition Explosives from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Ancient Waygates VI
rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to a seventh Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Expedition Inscription III
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Illusion Parchment: Magma Missile from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Quack-E Quack Modulator
rewards.description: You may acquire the Quack-E Voice Modulator, a crucial component of a Quack-E mechanical companion, from Pathfinder Jeb at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Engineering III
rewards.description: You may acquire Schematic: Quack-E from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Expedition Tailoring IV
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Duck-Stuffed Duck Lovie from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Jeweled Whelpling Treasure Maps
rewards.description: You may acquire special Treasure Maps from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp. These maps lead to Jeweled Whelpling materials and jewelcrafting patterns.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts III

rewards.description: Seek out Thaelin Darkanvil at the Rubyscale Outpost up the hill from the Dragonscale Basecamp to pursue access to the eighth Ancient Waygate.

rewards.name: Crafter's Knowledge II
rewards.description: You will receive additional Dragonscale Expedition crafter's knowledge from Boss Magor at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Dragon Isles Supplies
rewards.description: Seek out Cataloger Jakes in the Dragonscale Basecamp to receive a Dragonscale Expedition Supply Pack.

rewards.name: Skitterflying
rewards.description: You may acquire two skitterfly mounts (Tamed Skitterfly, Azure Skitterfly) from Granpap Whiskers at the Dragonscale Basecamp.

rewards.name: Intrepid Explorer
rewards.description: You may now use the well-earned title "Intrepid Explorer".

rewards.name: A Heroic Reward
rewards.description: Speak to Cataloger Jakes in the Dragonscale Basecamp to receive a Primal Infusion. This can be used as an optional reagent to increase a crafted item's level.

major_factions.name: Iskaara Tuskarr
major_factions.description: The Iskaara Tuskarr have been on the Dragon Isles for generations, living in harmony and telling tales of the world around them.
major_factions.unlock_description: Complete the quest To Iskaara near the Brackenhide Hollow in the Azure Span.

rewards.name: The Iskaara Tuskarr
rewards.description: You have begun to build a relationship with the Iskaara Tuskarr.

rewards.name: Sacred Tuskarr Totems
rewards.description: You may speak with Elder Poa to learn to identify and recover stolen Sacred Tuskarr Totems.

rewards.name: Community Feasts
rewards.description: You may join in preparing tuskarr Community Feasts, earning acclaim among the Iskaara and (when eaten) a food buff. Speak to Big Kinook in Iskaara to learn more.

rewards.name: Cooking Supplies
rewards.description: You may acquire the toys Tuskarr Traveling Soup Pot and Whale Bone Tea Set and the cosmetic appearances Tuskarr Clobbering Board, and Tuskarr Ulu Knife from Lil Ki in Iskaara.
rewards.toast: Cooking Toys and Tool Appearances Unlocked

rewards.name: Fishing Holes
rewards.description: You may find rare fish pools with unique activities in fishing holes around the Dragon Isles.

rewards.name: Fishing Nets I
rewards.description: You may speak with Tavio in Iskaara to get help creating a fishing net. Tuskarr fishing nets can be set up to catch fish automatically over time.

rewards.name: Worldly Story Scrolls
rewards.description: You may now find an uncommon tuskarr story scroll each week in your adventures in the outdoor world of Dragonflight zones. These scrolls can be turned in to Elder Poa for a reward.

rewards.name: Highlands Fishing
rewards.description: You may craft a tool to help you find fishing nodes in the highest pools and lakes of the Dragon Isles. Visit Tavio in Iskaara to learn this most high tuskarr secret.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Headwear
rewards.description: You may acquire eight warm cosmetic headwear appearances from Omapurita in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Fishing Harpoon I
rewards.description: You may craft an Iskaaran harpoon to fish up large sea creatures of the Dragon Isles. Visit Tavio in Iskaara to learn more.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts I
rewards.description: You may acquire four new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Highland Drake (Spiked Cheek, Multi-Horned Head, Bushy Brow, Finned Neck) from Norukk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Bonus Supplies I
rewards.description: You gain a 25% chance to get additional Dragon Isles Supplies from floral and other plant-based treasures.

rewards.name: Stablemaster-in-Training
rewards.description: You may acquire two new battle pets (Whiskuk, Backswimmer Timbertooth) from Jiq in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Ice Fishing
rewards.description: You may craft a tool to help you find new fishing nodes in the ice of the Dragon Isles. Visit Tavio in Iskaara to learn this chilling tuskarr secret.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Jewelcrafting I
rewards.description: You may acquire Design: Kalu'ak Figurine, Design: Sensei's Alexstraszite, Design: Keen Ysemerald, Design: Radiant Alexstraszite, and Design: Energized Ysemerald from Rokkutuk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Enchanting
rewards.description: You may acquire the Formula: Enchant Cloak - Regenerative Leech and Formula: Enchant Chest - Accelerated Agility from Rokkutuk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Dragon Isles Supplies
rewards.description: Seek out Murik in Iskaara to receive a Small Iskaaran Supply Pack.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Trader's Gear
rewards.description: You may aquire the cosmetic Tuskarr Trader's Cloak appearance and the cosmetic leather Trader's Ensemble from Lontupit in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Fishing Nets II
rewards.description: You may upgrade your fishing nets to catch more fish and/or catch fish faster. Visit Tavio in Iskaara to learn more.

rewards.name: Drakewatcher Manuscripts II
rewards.description: You may acquire three new Drakewatcher Manuscripts for your Highland Drake (Bladed Tail, Large Spotted Pattern, Thorn Horns) from Norukk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Inscription I
rewards.description: You may acquire Technique: Highland Drake: Black Hair from Norukk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Equipment I
rewards.description: You may acquire useful bracers from Arvik in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Crafter's Knowledge I
rewards.description: You will receive Iskaaran crafter's knowledge from Rokkutuk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Lava Fishing
rewards.description: You may craft a tool to help you find new fishing nodes in the lava of the Dragon Isles. Visit Tavio in Iskaara to learn this sweltering tuskarr secret.

rewards.name: Dungeon-Delver's Story Scrolls
rewards.description: You may now find a rare tuskarr story scroll each week in your adventures in the dungeons of Dragonflight. These scrolls can be turned in to Elder Poa for a reward.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Leatherworking I
rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Allied Heartwarming Fur Coat and Pattern: Snowball Makers from Rokkutuk in Iskaara.

rewards.name: Tuskarr Jewelcrafting II

rewards.description: You may acquire Pattern: Shockproof Gloves, Pattern: Lavish Floral Pack, Pattern: Resplendent Cover, and Pattern: Expert Skinner's Cap from Rokkutuk in Iskaara.
